class.name: DataTable
class.brief_description: A table of typed columns described by a [DataSchema], stored column by column.

method.name: _erase_cell
method.description: Storage: makes the cell absent. Called by [method erase_cell] and [method set_row] with valid indices for a present cell.

method.name: _get_cell
method.description: Storage: returns the value of a present cell, of the column type. Called with valid indices, only after [method _has_cell] returned [code]true[/code].

method.name: _get_row_count
method.description: Storage: returns the number of rows.

method.name: _has_cell
method.description: Storage: returns [code]true[/code] if the cell is present, [code]false[/code] if it is absent.

method.name: _insert_column
method.description: Storage: inserts a column at [param column] whose cells are all absent. The column is already in [member schema] when this is called.

method.name: _insert_rows
method.description: Storage: inserts [param count] rows at [param row] whose cells are all absent. The rows at and after [param row] move down.

method.name: _remove_column
method.description: Storage: removes the cells of the column at [param column]. The column is still in [member schema] when this is called.

method.name: _remove_rows
method.description: Storage: removes [param count] rows starting at [param row]. The rows after them move up.

method.name: _set_cell
method.description: Storage: sets the cell and makes it present. [param value] is already converted to the column type.

method.name: add_column
method.description: Adds a column named [param name] of type [param type] at the position [param at] ([code]-1[/code]: at the end). Its cells are absent in every row. [constant TYPE_NIL] makes a column that holds any [Variant]. A new [DataField] is added to [member schema]; set its rules (range, enum, required) through [method DataSchema.get_field]. Prints an error if the name is empty or already used, or if [param type] is not a data type ([constant TYPE_OBJECT], [constant TYPE_RID], [constant TYPE_CALLABLE] and [constant TYPE_SIGNAL] are not).

method.name: add_row
method.description: Adds a row at the end. [param values] maps column names to values; the cells of the other columns are absent. Values are converted to the column type (text and numbers convert); a value that does not convert, and a key that is not a column, prints an error and is left out.

method.name: create_from_csv
method.description: Creates a table from the rows of [param csv]. The columns are named after [member CSV.header] (or [code]column_1[/code], [code]column_2[/code], … without one). The matching field of [param schema] (by header name, or by position without a header) is copied into the table's schema with its type and rules; other columns are [String] columns. Cells are converted from text to the column type. An empty cell of a typed column, and a cell that does not convert, is absent; a warning reports the number of cells that do not convert.

method.name: create_from_records
method.description: Creates a table from an [Array] of [Dictionary] records, such as a parsed JSON, YAML or TOML array. The columns are the keys of all records, in the order they first appear. A column gets the type of its values if they all have the same type ([int] and [float] together give [float]); otherwise it holds any [Variant]. A key that a record does not have is an absent cell, so [method to_records] gives back the same records.

method.name: erase_cell
method.description: Makes the cell absent: [method has_cell] returns [code]false[/code] and the key is left out of [method get_row]. Does nothing if the cell is already absent.

method.name: find_column
method.description: Returns the index of the column named [param name], or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: find_rows
method.description: Returns the rows whose cell in [param column] equals [param value], converted to the column type first. Absent cells never match.

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns the value of the cell, or [code]null[/code] if it is absent. Use [method has_cell] to tell an absent cell from a [code]null[/code] value in a column without a fixed type.

method.name: get_column
method.description: Returns the cells of [param column] as one array: a [PackedInt64Array] for an [int] column, a [PackedFloat64Array] for a [float] column, a [PackedStringArray] for a [String] column, a [PackedByteArray] of [code]0[/code] and [code]1[/code] for a [bool] column, and an [Array] for any other column. Absent cells hold the default value of the type ([code]0[/code], [code]""[/code], [code]null[/code]). For a table in memory the array is returned without copying the cells; it is copied only when one of them changes.

method.name: get_column_count
method.description: Returns the number of columns, the number of fields of [member schema].

method.name: get_column_name
method.description: Returns the name of the column, the [member DataField.name] of its field.

method.name: get_column_type
method.description: Returns the type of the column. [constant TYPE_NIL] means the column holds any [Variant].

method.name: get_row
method.description: Returns the present cells of the row as a [Dictionary] of column names ([String]) and values, in column order. Absent cells are left out.

method.name: get_row_count
method.description: Returns the number of rows.

method.name: has_cell
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the cell is present, [code]false[/code] if it is absent.

method.name: insert_row
method.description: Inserts a row at [param row] (up to [method get_row_count]) with the cells in [param values], like [method add_row]. The rows at and after [param row] move down.

method.name: remove_column
method.description: Removes the column and its cells, and its field from [member schema].

method.name: remove_rows
method.description: Removes [param count] rows starting at [param row]. Prints an error if a row is out of range.

method.name: rename_column
method.description: Renames the column (its field in [member schema]). Prints an error if the name is empty or used by another column.

method.name: set_cell
method.description: Sets the cell to [param value], converted to the column type (for example the text [code]"42"[/code] or the float [code]42.0[/code] in an [int] column). Prints an error and keeps the cell if the value does not convert. To make a cell absent, use [method erase_cell].

method.name: set_column_type
method.description: Changes the type of the column and converts its cells (text and numbers convert, as when a cell is set). Cells that do not convert become absent; the returned [DataValidation] lists them as [constant DataValidation.ISSUE_KIND_TYPE_MISMATCH] with their row and column, so they can be shown or undone.

method.name: set_row
method.description: Replaces the cells of the row with [param values]: the cells of columns that [param values] does not have become absent.

method.name: sort_rows
method.description: Sorts the rows by the cells of [param column]. The sort is stable: rows with equal cells keep their order. Absent cells come last in both orders. In a column without a fixed type, values of different types are ordered by type. This changes the data. A view that only shows the rows in another order sorts its own row order instead.

method.name: to_csv
method.description: Returns the table as a [CSV] resource: the column names as [member CSV.header] and one row of text per table row. Absent cells are empty; numbers, [bool]s and text are written plainly, other values with [method @GlobalScope.var_to_str].

method.name: to_records
method.description: Returns the rows as an [Array] of [Dictionary] records, as [method get_row] returns them. Absent cells are left out. The result can be written as JSON, YAML or TOML.

method.name: validate
method.description: Validates the rows against the rules of [member schema] (required fields, unique values, ranges, enums, patterns) and returns every issue with its row. See [method DataSchema.validate].

members.member: The columns of the table: one [DataField] per column, in column order. The table creates its own schema; assign a saved [DataSchema] to share the columns between tables. When a schema is assigned, the cells of each column follow the field of the same name. Setting [code]null[/code] gives the table a new empty schema.

signal.name: cells_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the cells of a block changed (set, erased or reordered): [param row_count] rows from [param row] and [param column_count] columns from [param column].

signal.name: columns_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a column was added, removed, renamed or retyped, or when [member schema] changed. The cells of every row may have moved.

signal.name: rows_inserted
signal.description: Emitted after [param count] rows were inserted at [param row].

signal.name: rows_removed
signal.description: Emitted after [param count] rows starting at [param row] were removed.
